in_sanskrit.name: ध्येय
in_sanskrit.meaning: ध्यायतु (dhyaatu) - to meditate, य (i) - instrumental suffix, े (e) - nominative singular, य (i) - instrumental singular
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: That which is to be meditated upon, that which is to be contemplated

in_hindi.name: ध्येय
in_hindi.meaning: ध्यान देना (dhyāna dena) - to bestow attention
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who is worthy of meditation, He who is to be contemplated

in_tamil.name: தியேய
in_tamil.meaning: தியல்லாமல் (tihallāmal) - not to be left out, யேய (yēy) - suffix indicating a person, place or thing worthy of reverence
in_tamil.long_meaning: That which is not to be left out, that which is worthy of reverence and meditation

in_telugu.name: ధ్యేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who is worthy of meditation, that which is to be contemplated

in_marathi.name: Dhyey
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhyey हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'dhyai' meaning 'to meditate'. This name symbolizes deep concentration and introspection. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a sage who dedicated his life to self-realization.

This name symbolizes deep concentration and introspection. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a sage who dedicated his life to self-realization.
